title: Invertibility of the ordinary proper/open mate
statement: For schemes U,V,W,Z, quasi-compact open immersions k:U→V and i:W→Z, proper morphisms r:U→W and p:V→Z, and an equality kp=ri, the prescribed clopen-projection proper/open mate [lem-sf-proper-open-projection-mate] is a natural isomorphism on the entire unbounded derived category of constant modules over every finite commutative ring A. No Cartesian, boundedness or constructibility hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Tags 0F7B--0F7K; agent expansion of the blueprint composition/refinement calculation

proof.text: Apply the existing general proper/open square support theorem to the intrinsic finite-coefficient module categories. Transfer its supported object to constant-module sheaves using the specified derived realization and direct-image comparisons. Support is membership in the essential image of fully faithful open extension, so this transfer gives invertibility of the actual open counit without identifying chosen adjunction structures. For a finite ring in universe u+1, first shrink it into universe u, then lift it back; the resulting ring equivalence induces equivalences of sheaf and derived categories commuting with direct image and open extension. Direct image commutes with coefficient restriction on the nose, and K-injective descent gives its derived comparison.

Let s:U→V×_Z W be the canonical clopen lift, with projections b and q. Take beta to be the prescribed Cartesian open comparison, d:J_s J_b≅J_k the prescribed open composition, and e:P_r≅P_q P_s the prescribed pullback composition. Let t:J_s≅R_s be the inverse closed-range comparison. Define delta:R_s R_q≅R_r directly as the adjunction conjugate of e. The categorical adjunct comparison built from beta,d,t,delta is therefore an isomorphism.

The prescribed alpha is definitionally the beta/projector/compositor word. Its clopen projector is the proper unit followed by t inverse. Naturality of t cancels t inverse against t, leaving the unit of the composite proper adjunction. The generic categorical adjunct-comparison identity then says that the open adjunct of properOpenMate composed with the comparison of the preceding step is identity. Cancel this isomorphism and invert the open Hom equivalence: every mate component is open extension of the inverse comparison followed by the supported counit from Step 1. Both factors are invertible. Componentwise invertibility makes the natural transformation invertible.
